Add a README to turn this project home i.en: Add a README to turn this project home into a useful landing page for contributors.
Add a README to turn this project home i.zh: 添加 README，为贡献者提供实用的项目首页。

Add masked variables for tokens, deploym.en: Add masked variables for tokens, deployment keys, and environment values that jobs need at runtime. Use protected variables for release credentials and re-run the pipeline after saving.
Add masked variables for tokens, deploym.zh: 为作业运行所需的令牌、部署密钥和环境值添加脱敏变量。发布凭据请使用受保护变量，保存后重新运行流水线。

Artifacts are produced by CI script jobs.en: Artifacts are produced by CI script jobs. If none appear, confirm the pipeline job declares artifact paths and the script reaches upload.
Artifacts are produced by CI script jobs.zh: 产物由 CI 脚本作业生成。如果没有产物，请确认作业声明了产物路径，且脚本执行到了上传步骤。

Browse organization namespaces, open pro.en: Browse organization namespaces, open project repositories, and copy clone URLs from one workspace.
Browse organization namespaces, open pro.zh: 在同一工作区浏览组织命名空间、打开项目仓库并复制克隆地址。

Create a manual pipeline to validate CI.en: Create a manual pipeline to validate CI config, or push commits to let pipelines appear here automatically.
Create a manual pipeline to validate CI.zh: 手动创建流水线以验证 CI 配置，或推送提交以自动触发流水线。

Create a project in this organization to.en: Create a project in this organization to get started.
Create a project in this organization to.zh: 在此组织中创建项目以开始使用。

Create the first issue to start triage f.en: Create the first issue to start triage for this project.
Create the first issue to start triage f.zh: 创建第一个议题，开始处理项目事项。

Deployments using this key will no longe.en: Deployments using this key will no longer be trusted by this project.
Deployments using this key will no longe.zh: 此项目将不再信任使用该密钥的部署。

Describe user-facing changes, upgrade no.en: Describe user-facing changes, upgrade notes, and known limitations.
Describe user-facing changes, upgrade no.zh: 描述用户可见的变化、升级说明和已知限制。

Enqueue a manual job to validate runner.en: Enqueue a manual job to validate runner connectivity, or wait for a pipeline to create jobs automatically.
Enqueue a manual job to validate runner.zh: 添加手动作业以验证 Runner 连接，或等待流水线自动创建作业。

Existing automation using this token wil.en: Existing automation using this token will stop working immediately.
Existing automation using this token wil.zh: 使用此令牌的现有自动化任务将立即停止工作。

Install runners only on machines allowed.en: Install runners only on machines allowed to read repository workspaces and injected variables.
Install runners only on machines allowed.zh: 仅在获准读取仓库工作区和注入变量的主机上安装 Runner。

Manage repository tags, release notes, a.en: Manage repository tags, release notes, and external release asset links.
Manage repository tags, release notes, a.zh: 管理仓库标签、发布说明和外部发布资源链接。

Masked values are hidden after save and.en: Masked values are hidden after save and redacted from job logs, but jobs can still read them at runtime.
Masked values are hidden after save and.zh: 脱敏值在保存后隐藏，并从作业日志中遮蔽，但作业运行时仍可读取。

Masked variables are injected into scrip.en: Masked variables are injected into script jobs and redacted from logs.
Masked variables are injected into scrip.zh: 脱敏变量会注入脚本作业，并从日志中遮蔽。

Offline runner. Check the runner process.en: Offline runner. Check the runner process, trusted host network, and token configuration.
Offline runner. Check the runner process.zh: Runner 已离线。请检查进程、受信主机网络和令牌配置。

Online, but no heartbeat timestamp is av.en: Online, but no heartbeat timestamp is available. Verify runtime toolchains if jobs are still failing.
Online, but no heartbeat timestamp is av.zh: Runner 在线，但没有心跳时间。如果作业仍失败，请检查运行环境工具链。

Pending jobs need an active runner whose.en: Pending jobs need an active runner whose tags satisfy the job tags declared in the CI config.
Pending jobs need an active runner whose.zh: 待处理作业需要处于启用状态、且标签符合 CI 配置要求的 Runner。

Project activity, organization scope, an.en: Project activity, organization scope, and account access in one workspace.
Project activity, organization scope, an.zh: 在同一工作区查看项目动态、组织范围和账户访问权限。

Protected marks secrets intended for pro.en: Protected marks secrets intended for protected refs or release jobs; keep deployment credentials protected and scoped.
Protected marks secrets intended for pro.zh: 将用于受保护引用或发布作业的秘密标记为受保护变量；部署凭据应保持保护并限定范围。

Register a project runner on a trusted h.en: Register a project runner on a trusted host before pipelines can claim CI jobs on this repository. Add tags that match your CI config, then verify the runner sends heartbeats.
Register a project runner on a trusted h.zh: 在受信主机上注册项目 Runner 后，才可领取此仓库的 CI 作业。添加与 CI 配置匹配的标签，并确认 Runner 发送心跳。

Repository, CI, and collaboration activi.en: Repository, CI, and collaboration activity will appear here after events are emitted.
Repository, CI, and collaboration activi.zh: 事件产生后，仓库、CI 和协作动态将在此显示。

Review project activity that needs your.en: Review project activity that needs your attention, then clear it from the queue.
Review project activity that needs your.zh: 查看需要关注的项目动态，处理后将其移出队列。

Select a source file from the left to op.en: Select a source file from the left to open in Monaco.
Select a source file from the left to op.zh: 从左侧选择源文件，在 Monaco 中打开。

The runner host provides shell tools, co.en: The runner host provides shell tools, containers, caches, and network access; keep that runtime patched and scoped.
The runner host provides shell tools, co.zh: Runner 主机提供 Shell 工具、容器、缓存和网络访问；请及时更新运行环境并限制访问范围。

This file is binary cannot be shown in M.en: This file is binary cannot be shown in Monaco.
This file is binary cannot be shown in M.zh: 此文件为二进制文件，无法在 Monaco 中显示。

This force-unlocks the file for the proj.en: This force-unlocks the file for the project.
This force-unlocks the file for the proj.zh: 这将强制解除此项目中的文件锁。

This removes only the project-specific r.en: This removes only the project-specific role. Organization membership is not changed.
This removes only the project-specific r.zh: 仅移除此项目中的角色，组织成员关系保持不变。

Track bugs, tasks, ownership, labels, an.en: Track bugs, tasks, ownership, labels, and discussions for this project.
Track bugs, tasks, ownership, labels, an.zh: 跟踪此项目的缺陷、任务、负责人、标签和讨论。

Tracked large files will appear here aft.en: Tracked large files will appear here after the first LFS push.
Tracked large files will appear here aft.zh: 首次通过 LFS 推送后，受跟踪的大文件将在此显示。

Treat runner tokens like deployment secr.en: Treat runner tokens like deployment secrets. Runners execute repository scripts and can receive CI variables, so install them only on hosts you trust and can patch.
Treat runner tokens like deployment secr.zh: 请像保护部署凭据一样保护 Runner 令牌。Runner 会执行仓库脚本并接收 CI 变量，因此仅应安装在受信且可维护更新的主机上。

Your current project role can inspect ap.en: Your current project role can inspect approval rules, but cannot change them.
Your current project role can inspect ap.zh: 当前项目角色可以查看审批规则，但不能修改。

Your current project role can inspect me.en: Your current project role can inspect members, but cannot change project membership.
Your current project role can inspect me.zh: 当前项目角色可以查看成员，但不能更改项目成员关系。

Your current project role can inspect re.en: Your current project role can inspect releases, but cannot change them.
Your current project role can inspect re.zh: 当前项目角色可以查看发布，但不能修改。

Your current project role can inspect ru.en: Your current project role can inspect runners, but cannot change CI variables.
Your current project role can inspect ru.zh: 当前项目角色可以查看 Runner，但不能修改 CI 变量。
